title: Pip Cloud Post
description: Endless cloud survival! Pip bounces automatically. Steer, slam with A for a super spring, and use B to blow away nearby rain. Storms get faster and denser every 20 seconds. Four hearts; survive as long as you can and beat your personal record. F fullscreen. Windows installer available. Clean gameplay HUD; daylight cloud post art direction.

scenarios.name: bouncing collects letters without ending the run
an active player survives into faster waves
standing still eventually loses and saves personal progress
play again retains your personal records
